scope: planar radial screening only; not an IK, orientation, payload, singularity, or collision proof

screening_assumption.warning: The assumed base axis is not a released installation datum. Distances below ignore target Z, tool orientation, approach and retreat poses, joint limits, singularities, payload, cable load, and collisions.

sensitivity_case.description: Move the assumed base axis 100 mm behind the board while retaining X=305 mm.

release_blockers: freeze and measure the complete board-to-robot-base six-degree-of-freedom transform T_board_base
measure the installed clamp-edge-to-base-axis offset and board/clamp deflection
freeze each complete tool TCP, mass, inertia, contact geometry, and cable load
define every approach, contact, and retreat pose with required orientation
run IK with joint-limit, singularity, payload, and clearance margins against collision geometry
perform de-energized clearance checks followed by reduced-speed empty-cell sweeps
retain vision correction and compliant contact because published robot repeatability is much looser than fixture placement tolerances
release_rule: Do not claim target reachability or authorize powered contact while status is SCREENING_ONLY_NOT_PROVEN.
